def checkpoint_tiles(use_short=False):
    # sort checkpoints by modification time descending (newest first)
    def mtime(info):
        try:
            return os.path.getmtime(info.filename)
        except Exception:
            return 0
    sorted_infos = sorted(checkpoints_list.values(), key=mtime, reverse=True)
    return [x.short_title if use_short else x.title for x in sorted_infos]
